parameters.command:
CLIP_IDX={{ $runIndex + 1 }}
OUTDIR={{ $('Set Variables').first().json.OUTPUT_DIR }}
ASS_FILE=$(ls $OUTDIR/subs/raw_clip_${CLIP_IDX}.ass 2>/dev/null | head -1)

if [ -n "$ASS_FILE" ]; then
  ffmpeg -y -i "$OUTDIR/cropped_clip_${CLIP_IDX}.mp4" \
    -vf "ass=${ASS_FILE}" \
    -c:v libx264 -preset fast -crf 22 -c:a copy \
    "$OUTDIR/subbed_clip_${CLIP_IDX}.mp4" 2>&1 && echo DONE
else
  cp "$OUTDIR/cropped_clip_${CLIP_IDX}.mp4" "$OUTDIR/subbed_clip_${CLIP_IDX}.mp4"
  echo "No ASS file found, using cropped clip"
fi

CLIP_IDX={{ $runIndex + 1 }}
OUTDIR={{ $('Set Variables').first().json.OUTPUT_DIR }}
HOOK="{{ $json.hook_text }}"
FONT=/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf

if [ -n "$HOOK" ]; then
  SAFE_HOOK=$(echo "$HOOK" | sed "s/'/\\\\'/g")
  ffmpeg -y -i "$OUTDIR/subbed_clip_${CLIP_IDX}.mp4" \
    -vf "drawtext=fontfile=${FONT}:text='${SAFE_HOOK}':fontsize=64:fontcolor=white:borderw=4:bordercolor=black:x=(w-text_w)/2:y=(h*0.08):enable='between(t,0,3)'" \
    -c:v libx264 -preset fast -crf 22 -c:a copy \
    "$OUTDIR/hooked_clip_${CLIP_IDX}.mp4" 2>&1 && echo DONE
else
  cp "$OUTDIR/subbed_clip_${CLIP_IDX}.mp4" "$OUTDIR/hooked_clip_${CLIP_IDX}.mp4"
  echo "No hook text"
fi

CLIP_IDX={{ $runIndex + 1 }}
OUTDIR={{ $('Set Variables').first().json.OUTPUT_DIR }}
CHANNEL="{{ $('Set Variables').first().json.CHANNEL_NAME }}"
FONT=/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf

DURATION=$(ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of default=noprint_wrappers=1:nokey=1 "$OUTDIR/hooked_clip_${CLIP_IDX}.mp4")
CTA_START=$(echo "$DURATION - 3" | bc)

ffmpeg -y -i "$OUTDIR/hooked_clip_${CLIP_IDX}.mp4" \
  -vf "drawtext=fontfile=${FONT}:text='Watch full video →':fontsize=56:fontcolor=white:borderw=4:bordercolor=black:x=(w-text_w)/2:y=(h*0.78):enable='between(t,${CTA_START},${DURATION})',drawtext=fontfile=${FONT}:text='${CHANNEL}':fontsize=40:fontcolor=#FFD700:borderw=3:bordercolor=black:x=(w-text_w)/2:y=(h*0.84):enable='between(t,${CTA_START},${DURATION})'" \
  -c:v libx264 -preset fast -crf 22 -c:a copy \
  "$OUTDIR/cta_clip_${CLIP_IDX}.mp4" 2>&1 && echo DONE

CLIP_IDX={{ $json.clip_index }}
OUTDIR={{ $('Set Variables').first().json.OUTPUT_DIR }}
CLIP_FILE="{{ $json.final_file }}"

if [ -f "$CLIP_FILE" ]; then
  ffmpeg -y -i "$CLIP_FILE" \
    -af "loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-2:LRA=11:print_format=json" \
    -f null - 2>&1 | tail -20
fi

CLIP_IDX={{ $json.clip_index }}
OUTDIR={{ $('Set Variables').first().json.OUTPUT_DIR }}
FINAL="{{ $json.final_file }}"

# Extract frame at 20% into clip for thumbnail
DUR=$(ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of default=noprint_wrappers=1:nokey=1 "$FINAL")
THUMB_T=$(echo "$DUR * 0.20" | bc)

mkdir -p "$OUTDIR/thumbnails"
ffmpeg -y -ss $THUMB_T -i "$FINAL" -vframes 1 -q:v 2 \
  "$OUTDIR/thumbnails/raw_thumb_${CLIP_IDX}.jpg" 2>&1 && echo DONE

parameters.command:
OUTDIR={{ $('Set Variables').first().json.OUTPUT_DIR }}
echo '{{ JSON.stringify($json) }}' > "$OUTDIR/final_manifest.json"
echo "=== VIRAL CLIP FINDER COMPLETE ==="
echo "Selected clips:"
echo '{{ JSON.stringify($json.clips) }}' | python3 -c "import sys,json; [print(f\"  [{c['clip_index']}] Score:{c['score']} | {c['title']}\") for c in json.load(sys.stdin)]"
echo "Manifest: $OUTDIR/final_manifest.json"
